name: dawidnitka
description: Personal Claude Code marketplace providing foundational development tools, safety guardrails, and pre-configured integrations. Built around opinionated defaults that prioritize safety, code quality, and streamlined workflows.

plugins.name: base-setup
plugins.description: Foundational Claude Code configuration providing safety guardrails, automatic code formatting, MCP server integrations, and opinionated development defaults. The essential starting point for any Claude Code workflow.

plugins.name: coding-tutor
plugins.description: Personalized coding tutorials that use your real codebase for examples, with spaced-repetition quizzes and a commit-triggered learning nudge.

plugins.name: dev-extras
plugins.description: Optional developer tooling split out of base-setup: skill authoring with evals, PR/MR descriptions kept current by a push hook (GitHub and GitLab), and Chrome remote debugging wired to the chrome-devtools MCP server.
